hero.intro: A life shaped by hospitality, fermentation, sustainability, and the people who gather around a table.

about.title: A life built around hospitality, craft, and the people in the room.
paragraphs: My journey in hospitality began in the heart of Rome. At 13, I became captivated by the guitar while helping my mother at her fish stand. A year later, I stepped into the busy bar culture of Via Serpenti, making cappuccinos every day. The work taught me discipline and a strong work ethic.

By 15, I was making aperitivi and learning what hospitality could mean: making every guest feel valued. At 18, I moved to the United Kingdom, where I learned to live alone and manage my own finances. I kept working my way up, eventually becoming a group bar manager in Manchester and an active competitor in the cocktail scene.

That drive brought me to Toronto, where I co-founded Mother Cocktail Bar. We built a place around fermentation, thoughtful drinks, and honest, humble service. In 2022, I was named Canada's World Class Bartender of the Year. I later coached two global winners in the same competition, in 2023 and 2024.

Over the past four years, I've had the honour of travelling to many countries to share my love of hospitality, cocktail-making, and fermentation. My story is about craftsmanship, resilience, and believing that the journey—and the company we keep—matters as much as the destination.
about.quote: “I train like I’ve never won, and I compete like I’ve never lost.” — Eileen Gu

essays.title: Fermentation is a way of thinking
paragraphs: Many people see fermentation as a preserving technique developed by our ancestors to help them survive. I see it as much more: a way of life that deepens our understanding of how food and drink are made.

There is something incredible about creating something from scratch, with love and care at every step. Think of bread, koji, or kombucha: simple ingredients such as grain, rice, or sweet tea become warm loaves, layers of flavour, and lively bubbles. That transformation still sparks my curiosity, and I have not regretted a second of this journey.

essays.title: Sustain yourself first
paragraphs: Sustainability is often repeated in many forms, sometimes with the focus on reusing rather than preventing waste. We each approach it differently. My own principle is simple: “If you cannot sustain yourself, it’s unlikely you will sustain the people around you.”

Your body, your mind, your surroundings, and especially your time are essential to living sustainably and sharing that practice with others. That message can take root in your community, reach other communities, and become a chain of more sustainable living on our planet.

essays.title: An unexpected menu, a shared table
paragraphs: Before opening Mother Cocktail Bar, I had a professional dream: to work with chefs on food and cocktail pairings. When things did not go to plan, I started a side project built around culinary events where food and cocktails could come together.

I wondered what would happen if guests did not know the menu until they sat down. It would make the experience more challenging, mysterious, and personal. That idea gave the series its name: SECRET DINERS.

After almost 35 events, we brought the dinner series into restaurants, bars, and art galleries. I had the privilege of collaborating with many talented chefs. What began as a joke became one of the things I am proudest of professionally.

essays.title: A fermentation-led bar in Toronto
paragraphs: Mother Cocktail Bar is on Queen Street West in Toronto. Co-owned by bartender and bar operator Massimo Zitti, it is a place for innovative, fermentation-driven cocktails, sustainability, and humble guest service. Mother was named No. 7 on Canada's Best 100 in 2023 and No. 37 in North America's 50 Best Bars.

Mother began in 2019 with a group of like-minded people who felt Toronto needed something new. Over time, the small Queen Street cocktail bar grew into an internationally recognised destination for a new wave of cocktail-making, flavour discovery, and fermentation.
What makes me proudest is seeing staff and guests enjoy themselves, care for one another during service, and watching talented young professionals grow in their craft.

Mother has had the honour of collaborating with wonderful establishments, including Handshake Speakeasy (Mexico City), Overstory (New York City), Odd Couple (Shanghai), Passing Fancies (United Kingdom), Double Chicken Please, Gokan, Punch Room at Edition Hotel Tokyo, Nutmeg & Clove, and many others.
